description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420201
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and land characteristics) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) that covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related administrative determinations.
